endangerment.comment: German Sign Language (gsg-gsg) = 5 (Developing). Recognized language (2002, Disability Equality Act, Section 6(1)).

classification.sub: Swiss-German Sign Language [swis1240] is said to be similar to German Sign Language in South Germany (**hh:h:Boyes-Braem:Gebardensprache-Schweiz-Ausblick**):61 and there is a historical connection (**hh:soc:Boyes:Swiss-German-Sign**):90. Israeli Sign Language [isra1236] is related to German Sign Language according to (**hh:ssoc:MeirSandler:Israeli-Sign**:218-222, **hh:h:Abdel-Fattah:Sign-Western-Asia**:828 (**hh:h:Woll:Global-Sign**):29) on both lexical and historical evidence.
